title: Want $60K to Start a Business? WATCH THIS!
actionable_recommendations: Consider obtaining an Intuit QuickBooks subscription for access to credit offers.
Set up a business entity and obtain an Employer Identification Number (EIN).
Explore high-demand service side hustles for entrepreneurs and investors.
Use credit to fund a profitable business model that can generate more revenue.
claims_requiring_current_verification: The availability of a $60,000 line of credit from Intuit QuickBooks is subject to change.
The efficacy of using credit services to improve personal and business credit may vary based on circumstances.
Offers for credit, including the unsecured credit card program, may not always be available, and terms can differ.
intended_organization_or_user: Entrepreneurs seeking business funding and side hustle opportunities.
major_ideas: Access to capital is a major obstacle for entrepreneurs.
Intuit QuickBooks provides funding opportunities with minimal requirements.
Service-based businesses are currently in high demand, particularly among entrepreneurs and investors.
proposed_workflow: Obtain necessary business registrations and an EIN.
Subscribe to Intuit QuickBooks for potential credit access.
Identify high-demand services that can be offered to entrepreneurs and investors.
Use credit obtained to invest in or grow a business venture.
tools_templates_resources: Go High Level software for funnel setups
Free credit report audit services from specified websites
